thread:
maggie (PM): Proposing phased rollout for the tenant-flag lease + surge protections. Need ops/eng alignment on timeline + kill switches. PTAL @tom @kevin

tom (eng): Sketch looks good. quick Q: default off for low-tier tenants?

maggie (PM): Yes - default off for free/trial. plan: 1% warmup -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. keep canary short.

sara (prodops): Ops runbook needs explicit evict steps and an admin manual failover. Can we add those to the checklist?

kevin (sre): Recommend region-level circuit too. If GPU queue > 80% for 5m, then soft-fallback to smaller model variant. Also add p95 latency cutoff.

maggie (PM): Agreed. proposed thresholds: queue>80% for 5m OR p95 latency > 600ms -> fallback to variant-lite. Thoughts?

 tom (eng): Makes sense. Need telemetry: per-tenant latency, error-rate, and model-variant switch counts. Also we should capture token-cost delta.

deploy-bot: Flag created: rollout/lease-surge-protection v1 - id ff-2026-06-15-001
```
flag: rollout/lease-surge-protection
variants: [default, variant-lite]
rollout: start=1%, steps=[10,50,100]
abort_conditions: [errors>1%, p95>600ms, queue>80%_5m]
```

maggie (PM): I'll draft the launch checklist (canary windows, abort conditions, communication plan). Canary plan: 1% global -> NA 5% -> EU 20% -> rest.

kevin (sre): Add formal canary aborts: errors > 1% over 5m, latency delta > 25% vs baseline, or token-cost increase >20% sustained. Also automatic region cutover to fallback if region fails.

sara (prodops): Ops ack. I'll create the runbook and a short rollback gist. storing it here: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/lease-surge (will ping when ready)

tom (eng): Minor ask: include tenant opt-out API + an admin override to force a model variant. Might save a support ticket.

maggie (PM): Good call. I'll add opt-out + admin override to the scope. Scheduling shiproom for Tuesday; will post checklist in #product when done. :thumbsup:
